tomato.water: Keep soil evenly moist; avoid waterlogging.
tomato.soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter.
tomato.nutrition: Use balanced fertiliser; increase potassium during fruiting.

potato.water: Consistent moisture, especially during tuber formation.

pepper.water: Water deeply when the upper soil begins to dry.
pepper.nutrition: Balanced feed with extra potassium when fruiting.

apple.nutrition: Soil-test before fertilising; avoid excess nitrogen.

grape.water: Deep but infrequent watering once established.
grape.soil: Well-drained soil with good air circulation.

corn.water: Regular moisture during flowering and grain filling.
corn.nutrition: Nitrogen is important for vigorous growth.

strawberry.water: Keep roots moist but never saturated.
strawberry.nutrition: Moderate balanced fertiliser; avoid excessive nitrogen.
